outputs.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: full-resolution concept template for DeepLagoon / Space Station 14 shuttle console, landscape 1536x1024 if possible.
Input image: attached screenshot is a FUNCTIONAL LAYOUT REFERENCE, not an edit target. Redesign it as a highly polished industrial retro spacecraft computer UI. Produce ONE console only, fully visible edge-to-edge, orthographic straight-on view, no room, no desk, no people, no mockup board.
Keep the functional layout: huge circular navigation radar left occupying about 60% of the functional screen, compact telemetry and pilot settings and weapon list right occupying about 32%, top tabs. Radar diameter must stay large. Use sparse legible radar markers, range rings and a ship silhouette, avoid the dense overlapping text of the reference.
PRIMARY DESIGN A: gunmetal / charcoal brushed and painted steel chassis, dark glass screen with off-white typography, warm amber data and restrained desaturated cyan radar, muted brick-red physical buttons as an echo of the screenshot. Green only tiny status lamps, no green background wash. No neon cyberpunk.
USER'S KEY REQUEST: obvious PHYSICAL console appearance. Common reusable rectangular chassis, narrow but visible thick CRT monitor bevel, inset glass edge, angled side cheeks 4-5% each, visible short keyboard deck at bottom around 11% image height, keys convincingly drawn and compact, screw heads, side recessed carrying grip/vent and a tucked exposed ribbon cable. Keep straight outer geometry reusable across shuttle, weapons and mass scanner consoles.
The unused corners OUTSIDE the circular radar but INSIDE its rectangular housing get intentional restrained hardware: top-left riveted engraved alloy identification plate; top-right small warning strip and recessed screws; bottom-left exposed flat ribbon cable behind a small cutout; bottom-right clipped insulated wires and two status lamps. These elements must not intrude into circle. Radar remains largest visual element. Finite small utilitarian details rather than random greebles.
Top title exact Russian text: "КОНСОЛЬ ШАТТЛА". Top tab labels: "ПИЛОТ / ОРУДИЯ", "КАРТА / FTL", "СТЫКОВКА". Radar label: "НАВИГАЦИЯ". Right section labels: "ТЕЛЕМЕТРИЯ", "ПИЛОТИРОВАНИЕ", "УПРАВЛЕНИЕ ОРУДИЯМИ". Right rows include coordinates, azimuth, speed and six selectable gun rows labelled AK570 and ЦИРЕКСА, with small readiness bars. Nameplate "TSFMC • HALCYON". Footer short physical labels "NAV", "LINK", "PWR".
Style: crisp readable 2D game interface with tactile painted metal, subtle wear at screw edges, restrained fine pixel texture, realistic hardware detail but flat enough to implement as reusable 2D UI frame. No cinematic perspective. All important Russian headings spelled cleanly. Avoid excessive decorative text. This is the complete primary shuttle variant with a reusable neutral shell.

Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE full landscape 1536x1024 console template, straight-on orthographic view. Reference image is the dark shuttle console concept. Produce ALTERNATIVE B: same broad layout and reusable chassis proportions but light warm-gray industrial painted aluminum side cheeks and keyboard deck, black inset CRT glass, subdued navy blue radar, off-white typography, amber telemetry and small oxblood red rubber control buttons. No green wash. Slightly cleaner, less distressed metal than reference, fine utilitarian wear, no neon. Retain visible side carrying grips, vents, fasteners, narrow monitor bevel and compact bottom keyboard, all console fully visible no room/background. Main functional display still huge circular radar left, telemetry / pilot settings / weapons right, tabs top. Fill the four corners outside radar with riveted metal ID plaque, small cable ribbon inspection slot, tucked red/black wires, functional tiny status LEDs. Do not cover radar or shrink it. Legible exact Russian title "КОНСОЛЬ ШАТТЛА", tabs "ПИЛОТ / ОРУДИЯ", "КАРТА / FTL", "СТЫКОВКА", headings "ТЕЛЕМЕТРИЯ", "ПИЛОТИРОВАНИЕ", "УПРАВЛЕНИЕ ОРУДИЯМИ". Show six gun rows AK570 / ЦИРЕКСА. Sparse readable radar contacts. Match tactile 2D retro spacecraft game UI aesthetic; no perspective scene, no moodboard, no multiple consoles. This image is a complete alternative shuttle UI with a light-painted shell.

Create one full 1536x1024 orthographic 2D industrial game UI concept, using the reference dark metal shuttle console. Keep exactly the same outside chassis, side grips and vents, monitor bezel, screws, bottom keyboard and materials. Change screen to ship weapons control. Russian title "КОНТРОЛЬ ОРУДИЙ". Large circular tactical radar left with muted amber rings, cyan contacts and one orange targeting bracket; preserve metal plaque, ribbon cable and clipped wires in the unused corners OUTSIDE the circle. Right column: "СЕРВЕР ОРУДИЙ", status "ПОДКЛЮЧЕНО", buttons "ОБНОВИТЬ", "ВСЕ", "СНЯТЬ"; filters "БАЛЛИСТИКА", "ЭНЕРГИЯ", "РАКЕТЫ"; "IFF", "ПОДРОБНО", "ДОКИ". Six AK570 / ЦИРЕКСА selectable rows with readiness bars; small "ЩИТ" status bar. Dark gray metal, black glass, off-white labels, amber data, brick red physical keys, tiny green lamps only. No green screen wash. This is a different screen within the SAME reusable physical console shell, not a new hardware design. Fully visible console, straight-on, no room, no perspective scene, no collage.
outputs.refinement_prompt: Edit ONLY two text areas in this ship weapons console UI reference. Keep every other pixel, chassis, radar, contacts, color, controls and layout visually identical. Top three physical tab labels must read exactly "ОРУДИЯ", "РАДАР", "ЩИТ", replacing the shuttle navigation labels currently there. In the right column replace the heading "ФИЛЬТРЫ ЦЕЛЕЙ" with "ГРУППЫ ОРУДИЙ", because buttons underneath select weapon categories. No other changes. Same full 1536x1024 canvas and framing.
